CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.challenge_scores(p_device_id text, p_type text, p_date date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS TABLE(your_best integer, top_score integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with day as (select coalesce(p_date, (now() at time zone 'Europe/Bratislava')::date) as d),
  me as (select auth.uid() as u, nullif(trim(coalesce(p_device_id, '')), '') as dev)
  select
    (select max(r.score) from public.challenge_results r, day, me
      where r.challenge_type = p_type and r.challenge_date = day.d and r.timed
        and (case when me.u is not null then r.user_id = me.u else r.user_id is null and r.device_id = me.dev end))::integer,
    (select max(r.score) from public.challenge_results r, day
      where r.challenge_type = p_type and r.challenge_date = day.d and r.timed)::integer;
$function$
